interpretation: conditional short-horizon drift and variance per mother and arm; identification screen, no endpoint claims
selection_rationale: Short-horizon conditional moments from the same frozen mothers as the fate continuation: a_delta(X)=E[N_D(delta)-N_D(0)]/delta and b_delta(X)=Var[N_D(delta)-N_D(0)]/delta over 64 fresh clones per mother and arm, deltas 1/2/5/10/20. Identification screen separating net drift (predicted by J_pre) from interface random activity (predicted by the edge-count second-moment identity) and locating which moment the resource arms change first. Mother identity binding enabled; not a confirmatory test.
